messages:
maria: Quick sync — vendors sent updated roadmaps. Need to lock announcement & marketplace/onramp windows for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi. Who can confirm embargo+press windows? :eyes:
jamal: @maria saw the decks. H100 GA signals still 'tentative Q3' from NV, H200 more like 'late Q3 -> Q4' depending on supply. B200 OEM timeline looks stable for late Q2.
katie: Marketplace team: certification and images take ~3 weeks once we get hardware + golden AMI. Need final SKU list and test vectors.
sandeep: Lab capacity note — we can spin up validation nodes but need vendor images and kernel configs. Asking infra to reserve 8 B200s + 4 MI300 nodes for test matrix.
ryan: From comms: we need at least a 2-week embargo lead for joint PR and partner logos approvals. Also slotting for blog + press outreach. Any preferred press week windows?
jamal: Vendor update I got this morning (summarized):
```
NVIDIA: H100 tentative GA: 2026-09-15 (subject to silicon), H200 ribbon: 2026-11-01
AMD: MI300 steady shipments starting 2026-08-01 (channel limited Aug),
Gaudi: 3rd party partner kits landing 2026-07-10 - internal perf still tuning
B200: OEM releases 2026-06-20
```
maria: Good. Proposed internal timeline (high level):
- Week of 2026-06-22: B200 marketplace pre-cert starts
- Week of 2026-07-06: Gaudi lab validation + canary runs
- Week of 2026-08-03: MI300 early access customers onboarded
- Week of 2026-09-01: H100 embargo window opens (target GA mid-September)
- Week of 2026-11-01: H200 follow-up announcement / dedicated capacity available

maria: Action items: everyone please confirm by EOD Friday: vendor embargo windows, whether we need extended lab time, and any legal/partner approvals that might add latency.
jamal: Confirmed we need partner logo approvals + NV NDA clearance for pre-announce deck. I'll ping contacts.
katie: Marketplace: add 2-week cushion for AMI hardening + compliance scans.
sandeep: I'll book the nodes and post config snippet in #eng-infra.
ryan: Reserve press week options: 2026-09-13 or 2026-09-20. Prefer 9/20 if H100 slips.
vendor-nvidia-bot: Vendor update posted: https://vendor-bucket.internal/nv/roadmap-2026-06-18.pdf
marianote: small nit — please include perf baselines for each SKU in the announcement appendix. Consumers will ask.
maria: Good call. @sandeep can you and @jamal add perf baselines + canaries to the validation checklist?
sandeep: yes — will include: latency P50/P95, throughput @batch sizes [1,8,32], KV cache hit curves.
jamal: looping in partner ops to confirm embargo language.
maria: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll propose the 9/20 press week and draft the joint timeline doc. :rocket:
ryan: :thumbsup: please cc comms channel when draft ready.
katie: adding ticket in marketplace backlog now — ETA monday for AMI checklist.
jamal: pinged NV partner PMs, awaiting confirmation.
marianote: :eyes:
maria: Closing thread for now — will repost updated timeline once partners confirm.
